visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young male with voluminous, messy brown hair and a black face mask is seated indoors, wearing a grey crewneck sweatshirt. He looks directly at the lens, his hands occasionally rising into the frame to gesture as he speaks. The background consists of a window with neutral grey curtains, a marble-patterned wall, and a wooden cutting board on a counter. The lighting is bright, likely from overhead indoor fixtures. (2) The visual shifts to a digital document titled 商業登記基本資料 displayed on screen, partially obscured by red handwritten-style digital text. This is followed by a top-down view of a white kitchen counter crowded with various grocery items: boxes of Cheerful Crackers, bags of marshmallows, Swiss Miss chocolate, and Lindt bars. A hand enters to point at the items. The setting is a clean, modern kitchen environment. (3) The character is now seen in a different outfit, a white t-shirt with FOREVERKIDS printed on the sleeve, still masked but wearing clear plastic gloves. He is standing at a kitchen counter, meticulously scraping the white filling out of Oreo cookies with a yellow spatula. Behind him are white cabinets and a dark wooden door. The scene is brightly lit, emphasizing the textures of the cookies and tools. (4) In a series of medium shots, the man holds up specific product packages to the camera, such as a large blue bag of milk powder with cow illustrations, a small carton of BUTTER, and boxes of Swiss Miss. He gestures dynamically with the products. The background remains the domestic setting with curtains and a window. Some phases include overlays of price tags or supermarket screenshots. (5) The footage shows the man actively cooking, stirring a bubbling, dark brown mixture in a bright pink frying pan using a wooden spatula. He then demonstrates the manual process of pressing the mixture into a rectangular metal tray and cutting it into squares with a knife. He briefly holds his red, irritated palm toward the camera, showing the physical toll of the work. (6) The video transitions through several screenshots of order lists from 7-ELEVEN and social media comments with various user avatars. Finally, the screen turns entirely black, displaying centered white Chinese text that summarizes the production costs and the creator's philosophy. The text appears in two distinct blocks, fading in and out to provide a formal conclusion.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video aims to address and refute criticisms regarding the high price of the creator's handmade cookies. By showing high-quality ingredients, a business registration, and the labor-intensive production process, the creator justifies the cost and shares his sincere motivation behind the project.
